findings.issue: A generic `Algebra.Bialgebra` module imports `Algebra.AlgebraicGroup.GroupAlgebra.Torsion`; the imported results, including the new exponential-characteristic lemmas, concern only monoid algebras and create an algebraic-group dependency for broadly reusable bialgebra theory.

summary: The new generic bialgebra module introduces an inverted dependency on the algebraic-group subtree because the underlying monoid-algebra torsion theory is misplaced.
